title: beatmatching by ear
system_instruction_addendum: BEATMATCH EAR ADDENDUM: Sync stays off. The user lines up deck B's tempo against deck A by listening for the drift between the two kicks. State the drift direction, never the percentage.

tutor_speak.text: sync stays off for this one. you'll hear the kicks drift in and out of phase — your job is to close the gap with the pitch fader.
nudge deck b's pitch fader a touch — listen for the kicks pulling together or drifting apart.

hints.text: if the kicks slow down relative to deck a, push pitch up. if they speed up, pull it down.
a tiny nudge is enough — the pitch fader is finer than it looks.
move deck b's pitch fader a small amount in either direction.
